text:
Ari (Docs): Product asked for a super-slim migration note for v1->v2 invoke/generate: one-pager + 3 quick snippets + support triage. Can we do this by Wed?

Liz (API): Yes. Core deltas: model_id -> model, input -> messages array, streaming key token -> delta. We added X-Compat-Mode: v1 header for temporary compatibility.

Ari (Docs): Paste minimal cURL old vs new and a tiny JS shim please.

Liz (API): Old:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/invoke -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -d '{"model_id":"rwd-small","input":"Hi"}'`
New:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"model":"rwd-small-2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]}'`
JS shim:
`function shim(p){ if(p.model_id) return {model:p.model_id+"-2", messages:[{role:'user',content:p.input||''}]}; return p }`

Devon (SE): For Dedicated customers call out firewall/path change (/v2/*) and suggest canary routing.

Rafael (Support): I'll draft two canned replies: 1) quick workaround with X-Compat-Mode: v1, 2) escalation for high-volume customers.

Ari (Docs): Great — I'll open a tiny PR and ping reviewers. DocsBot: create draft when PR exists.

DocsBot: noted.

Ari (Docs): Plan: publish short note + snippet bundle Thursday AM, coordinated with in-app banner. If any objections speak now.

Liz (API): No objections. Adding performance note: compat shim may add ~5ms per request.
